summary: A Wisconsin resident files emails with American Transmission Company as evidence that incumbents avoid evaluating reconductoring and other upgrades as cheaper alternatives to a $350 million greenfield line.
ask: Add the attached correspondence to the record in the MISO show cause docket.

points.point: The commenter ties the filing to the June 18 orders directing evaluation of alternative transmission technologies.
points.quote: the Commission's June 18, 2026 orders directing RTOs to evaluate alternative transmission technologies and upgrades to accommodate large loads

points.point: The commenter asked ATC to evaluate reconductoring instead of the $350 million Viridon WISE line and says ATC did not answer.
points.quote: the incumbent utility refused to provide an answer and deflected the inquiry to the greenfield developer.

points.point: The commenter presents the emails as evidence that cheaper grid-enhancing options go unevaluated.
points.quote: incumbent utilities and developers in the MISO footprint are actively avoiding the evaluation of cost-effective Grid-Enhancing Technologies and existing line upgrades

throughLine.text: Public comment in the MISO docket tying a local project dispute to the E-8 directive to evaluate alternative transmission technologies in transmission service studies.
